coach_turns.utterance: what should I eat for better sleep

unsupported_claims: His teaching style focuses on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation.
Drinking water before meals is essential for kidney function.
Drinking water before meals helps flush out toxins.

raw.response:
Surya Namaskar is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas [PROG_Y_001]. It is best performed early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001]. One complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left [PROG_Y_001]. 

Each posture is coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001]. People with high blood pressure, hernia, or back problems should consult a doctor or certified instructor before performing it [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom ek powerful pranayama hai jo mind ko calm karta hai aur stress ko relieve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. Iske aur bhi fayde hain:

- Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein help karta hai [PROG_P_001].
- Yeh patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Start karne ke liye comfortable meditative pose mein straight spine ke sath baithein aur 5-10 rounds se start karein [PROG_P_001]. Best time subah (morning) breakfast se pehle hota hai [PROG_P_001]. Contraindication yeh hai ki agar aapko cold, cough, ya fever hai toh ise practice na karein [PROG_P_001].

Healthy lifestyle ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai jisme carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, aur minerals ka mix ho [PROG_D_001]. 

Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli lein [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jiske liye khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry ek accha option hai [PROG_D_001]. 

Din mein kam se kam 8-10 glasses paani (water) piyein aur processed sugar serta excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. Cravings ke liye nuts and seeds se snacking karein [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, also known as Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. 

Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. Start with 20-30 pumps and do up to 3 rounds with breaks [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates digestion, improves metabolic rate, and aids in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. 

Perform it on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning [PROG_P_002]. Avoid it if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose where you stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees, bend from the hips to place your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor, and extend your left arm up [PROG_Y_003]. 

It stretches your hamstrings, hips, and spine while strengthening your legs and core [PROG_Y_003]. This pose helps relieve stress and improves digestion, and you should hold it for 30-60 seconds without locking your knees [PROG_Y_003]. Avoid it if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain [PROG_P_004]. 

Comfortable baith kar apni tongue ko tube shape mein roll karke mouth se bahar nikalen [PROG_P_004]. Tube ke through slow aur deep inhale karen, phir tongue ko retract karke mouth close karen aur nostrils se slow exhale karen [PROG_P_004]. Isse body cool hoti hai, mental aur emotional excitation reduce hoti hai, aur hunger aur thirst control karne mein help milti hai [PROG_P_004]. Isko 5-10 times repeat karen [PROG_P_004].

Contraindications: Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale logon ke liye yeh recommended nahi hai [PROG_P_004]. Clean environment mein practice karen [PROG_P_004].

Immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet lena zaroori hai [PROG_D_002]. Apni diet mein citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons shamil karein jo Vitamin C ke acche source hain [PROG_D_002]. 

Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, ise milk ya curries mein add karein [PROG_D_002]. Ginger aur garlic bhi bahut faydemand hain [PROG_D_002]. Yogurt gut health ke liye probiotics deta hai [PROG_D_002]. Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se bhari hain, aur almonds mein Vitamin E milta hai [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience, having started his journey in Rishikesh under traditional yoga gurus [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment, breath, pranayama, and meditation [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga to help manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are considered a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle rather than just gaon ka khana [PROG_D_004]. 

Different types offer unique benefits, such as Ragi for calcium and bone health, Jowar for iron and protein, and Bajra for magnesium and heart health [PROG_D_004]. They have a low glycemic index, help keep you full longer to aid in weight management, and can be easily eaten by swapping rice or making rotis [PROG_D_004].

You can relax using Shavasana (Corpse Pose). Lie flat on your back with your feet apart and arms by your sides, palms up, and let go of breath control while releasing tension (*thakaan*) [PROG_Y_004]. Spend 5-10 minutes in this pose to help reduce blood pressure, calm the nervous system, and combat insomnia [PROG_Y_004]. 

Alternatively, try Balasana (Childs Pose) by kneeling, sitting back on your heels, and folding forward with your forehead on the floor [PROG_Y_005]. Hold this restorative pose for 30 seconds to a few minutes using deep, diaphragmatic breathing to calm the brain and relieve stress and fatigue [PROG_Y_005]. 

Would you like me to connect you with a care coordinator?

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She has helped over 500 clients reach their health goals, focusing on weight management and conditions like PCOS and diabetes through diet [PROG_I_002]. Her philosophy is to create sustainable, personalized meal plans based on Indian cuisine using a no-deprivation approach [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her to create a khaane ka plan (eating plan) tailored to your body's needs [PROG_I_002]. She is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health because water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration can cause headaches, fatigue, and poor concentration [PROG_D_003]. 

You should aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, and drink more if you exercise or if it is a hot day [PROG_D_003]. Drinking water before meals aids in weight management, is essential for kidney function, and helps flush out toxins [PROG_D_003].
